Reviewer evidence: TASK-260906-1uf713_review-findings-stage-c-5.md; listed by the launcher/migration campaign report as a trunk defect reproducible on main.

after.text: https://github.com/relux-works/curator/issues/73 — same defect as TASK-260907-187z6x (git same-source reinstall delegates to updateLocked and drops --use/--takeover; path reinstall was fixed by stage (c) rework 5). Sequencing 2026-09-22: 187z6x (running in STORY-1a2i5a) delivers the git-shape fix with eight run()-driven rows; this bug then covers the residual: verify every install shape incl. path reinstall with an unchanged lock under --use, add the stop-then-retry conformance vector (spec leaf if the vector family lives in curator-spec), and close issue #73 with the landed commits.
